evidence.evidence_text: Existing models typically focus on identifying specific types of dialogue knowledge and utilize corresponding datasets for training.

Both automatic and manual evaluation results validate the effectiveness of our framework in exploring and exploiting multi-source multi-type knowledge to generate coherent, informative, and fluent responses.
